title: fix: New Session shortcut gets blocked or loses focus
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes New Session doing nothing while keyboard-shortcuts help is open, and the composer losing focus when reopening a warm New Session page.

Related: #153537.

## User Impact

Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+O closes shortcut help and focuses a New Session draft. Cmd/Ctrl+/ closes help without navigation. Returning to an already loaded New Session page keeps typing in the composer. Existing drafts, permissions, approval dialogs, and archive safeguards are preserved.

## Why This Change Was Made

Help owns its two permitted navigation chords and releases its modal before handing off to the existing session action. Drawer cleanup restores focus only when the drawer was actually open, rather than stealing focus during ordinary desktop navigation.

## Evidence

### Compiler-policy repair

Published branch commit **9e04a1306f8ed9839b27e307fd36f33b41c19758** carries the existing approved Node compiler flags through all six SQLite reliability subprocess launch paths. The CLI shim and proof workers share the same existing four-flag filter; loaders, evals, and debugger arguments remain excluded. The test entrypoint uses the canonical test Node invocation.

The existing full smoke proof checks actual main-thread descendants with a preload guard. With the selected parent policy but original launches, the writer fails the missing-policy guard. With the repair, **all 7 SQLite proof tests pass** (25.51 seconds wall; smoke 20.229 seconds), retaining every snapshot, crash, restore, publication, index-repair, compaction, and child-settlement assertion. **Four selected real shim cases pass** (1.81 seconds wall); script/root-test types, lint, formatting, and independent P0–P2 review pass. No deadline, payload, assertion, or database guard changed.

CI run 35580513015 reached its one-hour job limit: the first benchmark attempt timed out at 241 seconds, its CI-managed replay passed at 123 seconds, and other tooling tests plus a later no-output stall also consumed the budget. This repair proves a compiler-policy propagation defect; it does **not** claim sole attribution of that job timeout or treat the replay as a fix. The earlier auto-merge request was retired and its native cancellation confirmed before this replacement was published. Completed exact-head CI and review remain required for landing.


### Current CI integration

Integration **d0d778888be441544a44580afea1aa65ba9026e6** includes the canonical [database-fixture teardown repair](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/103115f2f0b11844d5cf5766424b6ab8e1e5cf01): await agent-database resource drainage before shared-state closure and temporary-directory deletion, while preserving validation resets and asserting settled custody. It directly matches the ENOENT database-drain failure in CI run 35577677441; that run’s UI lanes and staging repair were not the failing jobs.

After integration, **all 9 affected library tests and all 16 staging tests pass** (32.05 s and 40.46 s wall). The UI implementation, lazy facade, and acquisition tests remain byte-identical to the reviewed repair. The staging fixture also preserves main’s [Node compiler-policy forwarding](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7205715961f0222bab7f77811d37d83b7bccada0). No database identity guard, deadline, assertion, or cleanup requirement was weakened. Fresh exact-head CI remains the landing gate.


### CI repair: keep protected local recovery lightweight

Repair commit **a72aa1b448cd008f8d71974c2e7b70f3e8feb7db** makes the existing Crabbox acquisition API lazy. Binary discovery remains synchronous; acquisition delegates to the unchanged managed-binary owner only when called. The static eager repository-module closure falls from **186 to 18** for the wrapper, and **171 to 2** for its public API facade.

The real protected-recovery CLI regression rejects command/PTY-runtime loading. It fails on the original eager boundary and passes on this repair. The full **16 staging tests and 36 binary/acquisition tests pass** (73.39 seconds wall); the affected staging case took 10.188 seconds. Production plugin types, root fixture types, formatting and both owning lint checks pass; independent P0–P2 review is clean. No command timeout, recovery assertion, process-tree cleanup, writer hold, or permission was relaxed.

The historical 30-second CI timeout remains unattributed; this repairs the concrete unnecessary startup dependency, rather than claiming a diagnosed Node shutdown/cache bug. Normal exact-head CI and review still gate landing. Keyboard/focus implementation and existing visual evidence are unchanged.


- Refreshed-head verification: **80 focused UI tests**, production UI types, and UI fixture types pass after integrating the landed runtime dependency. Fresh exact-head CI remains required. Prior browser/performance evidence below is retained with its original source bindings.

- Before-fix regressions reproduce both the ignored help shortcut and focus moving from the composer to the page container.
- 80 focused modal, shell, and keyboard tests pass. The browser regression fails on the original production code and passes on the candidate, covering help-to-draft navigation, stable focus, warm reopening, draft preservation, and archive remaining blocked in help.
- Independent P0–P2 code review: no actionable findings. Complete changed-scope checks passed for `31f50f61d97eb2a5a01d2806c0d195b8e4ed1eba`, including core-test/UI types, i18n, formatting, dead-export scans, lint, and UI style checks. Required exact-head CI gates landing.
- The startup-budget follow-up keeps help-only access checks and scope capture behind the lazy dialog boundary. The performance comparison passes at **364,802 B startup JS gzip**, under the unchanged **364,806 B** enforcement limit. The bundled browser regression was rerun successfully after this change.
- CI assertion follow-up in `28fab1b29aa04aaf046c749d777f0c09d3ea3c67`: progress assertions now target the active conversation’s **Progress note**, not mirrored text in the sidebar hovercard. All **16 browser tests** (startup suite plus shortcut regression), UI fixture types, targeted lint, and independent review pass. Existing text/visibility/RPC-count checks are unchanged; no retries or timeout increases. [Browser proof environment](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35546493124).
- Browser proof: Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01m2zs5nyear24wqebjdvz1kkp`, [run environment](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35521731834).
- Browser proof uses Chromium with a deterministic mock Gateway. It does not certify physical OS/browser accelerator delivery in every browser.

### Before / after

Before: the rendered help dialog swallows New Session. After: the same chord opens the draft. Both captures use synthetic data.

![Before: shortcut help blocks New Session](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ffd73086-2dcc-4583-b813-e3a7a299ed9f)

![After: shortcut opens the New Session draft](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c638ae5a-eaec-4a6b-8c86-873d53d1371a)

## Runtime dependency resolved

The owning native-runtime repair #154320 is merged on main at `7e07e547cbc9eb367a3895474cfdcad89df1428d`, after successful exact-head CI and normal native landing. The dependency refresh **bc1d8e1bc8f59dd82ef6453454293cc75db7befc** includes that commit. Its own production changes are byte-for-byte unchanged; upstream documentation and archive-button E2E changes were preserved. No failing CI result was waived or treated as green.
